kebab_example: aliyun adb create-spark-template --db-cluster-id amv-bp11q28kvl6880000 --parent-id 10 --name batchfile --type file --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSparkTemplate

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the Enterprise Edition, Basic Edition, or Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the folder to which the application template belongs.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/456218.html operation to query the folder ID
parameters.help_zh:
应用模板所属的目录ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/456218.html接口查询目录ID
parameters.name: parent_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the application template. The name can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 应用模板名称。长度不超过64个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The templatetype of the application template. Valid values:
folder: folder
file: application
parameters.help_zh:
应用模板类型，取值说明：
folder：目录
file：应用
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The templatetype of the application. Valid values:
SQL: SQL application
STREAMING: streaming application
BATCH: batch application

You do not need to configure this parameter when the application template type is folder
parameters.help_zh:
应用类型，取值说明：
SQL：SQL应用
STREAMING：流应用
BATCH：离线应用

当应用模板类型为folder时，无需配置此参数
parameters.name: app_type

Data.description_en: The result of creating the application template

Succeeded.description_en:
Indicates whether the creation is successful. Valid values:
True: Successful.
False: Failed
Succeeded.description_zh:
是否创建成功，取值说明：
True：成功
False：失败
